lines.zh: 发出阴森低吼，向前缓慢移动。
lines.en: Let out a sinister growl and move forward slowly.

lines.zh: 从洞穴深处发出嘶嘶声，步履蹒跚前行。
lines.en: Sssss in the depths, shuffling forward.

lines.zh: 挥动触手，缓慢爬行。
lines.en: Swing its tentacles and crawl slowly.

lines.zh: 发出闷哼声，继续缓缓前进。
lines.en: Let out a muffled grunt, continuing to advance slowly.

lines.zh: 在黑暗中蠕动，逼近玩家。
lines.en: Wriggle in the darkness, drawing closer to the player.

lines.zh: 触手探向玩家，发出咯吱声。
lines.en: Tentacles reach for the player, creaking.

lines.zh: 发出低沉的咆哮，逼近目标。
lines.en: Let out a low roar, closing in on the target.

lines.zh: 摸索着前进，发出轻微摩擦声。
lines.en: Feel its way forward, making soft scraping sounds.

lines.zh: 靠近玩家时发出沙哑的嘶鸣。
lines.en: Sputter a hoarse hiss when getting close to the player.

lines.zh: 低吼一声，迅速接近。
lines.en: Let out a low growl and approach quickly.

lines.zh: 我贴着洞壁滑行，影子跟着流动。
lines.en: I slide along the cave wall, my shadow flowing behind me.

lines.zh: 我的指尖在湿石上划出细长抓痕。
lines.en: My fingertips score thin marks into the wet stone.

lines.zh: 静静地站在阴影中，凝视着玩家。
lines.en: Stand quietly in the shadows, staring at the player.

lines.zh: 阴沉的目光盯住玩家，准备行动。
lines.en: Fix its sinister gaze on the player, ready to act.

lines.zh: 缓缓扭动身体，凝视着前方。
lines.en: Twist its body slowly, staring ahead.

lines.zh: 凝视着玩家，眼中闪烁着恶意。
lines.en: Stare at the player with malice in its eyes.

lines.zh: 在洞穴深处静静地等待时机。
lines.en: Wait quietly in the depths of the cave for the right moment.

lines.zh: 目光死死地盯着玩家，不肯移开。
lines.en: Fix its gaze unflinchingly on the player.

lines.zh: 在黑暗中隐匿身形，盯着玩家。
lines.en: Hide in the darkness, focusing on the player.

lines.zh: 凝视着玩家，仿佛能够洞察心灵。
lines.en: Stare at the player as if able to peer into its soul.

lines.zh: 静默无语，但目光锐利无比。
lines.en: Silent but its gaze sharp.

lines.zh: 在黑暗中悄无声息地注视着。
lines.en: Watch silently in the darkness.

lines.zh: 我数着洞顶滴落的水声。
lines.en: I count the water dripping from the cave roof.

lines.zh: 我在岩缝里收拢触手，屏住呼吸。
lines.en: I draw my tendrils into the crevice and hold my breath.

lines.zh: 我让黑暗一层层裹住自己。
lines.en: I let the darkness wrap around me, layer by layer.

lines.zh: 我静听更深处的回响。
lines.en: I listen to the echoes rising from deeper down.

lines.zh: 突然转向，目光锁定玩家。
lines.en: Suddenly turn, locking onto the player.

lines.zh: 目光转向玩家，露出凶光。
lines.en: Turn to the player, a vicious gleam in its eye.

lines.zh: 猛地转向玩家，视线锁定。
lines.en: Suddenly turn to the player, locking its gaze.

lines.zh: 盯紧玩家，发出沙哑的声音。
lines.en: Fix on the player, letting out a raspy sound.

lines.zh: 转向玩家，目光凶狠。
lines.en: Turn to the player, its gaze fierce.

lines.zh: 注视着玩家，身体绷紧。
lines.en: Stare at the player, its body taut.

lines.zh: 目光转移到玩家身上，身体颤抖。
lines.en: Transfer its gaze to the player, its body trembling.

lines.zh: 看向玩家，身体紧绷。
lines.en: Look at the player, its body taut.

lines.zh: 目光锁定玩家，身体发出咯吱声。
lines.en: Lock onto the player, its body creaking.

lines.zh: 凝视玩家，身体开始微微颤抖。
lines.en: Stare at the player, its body beginning to tremble.

lines.zh: 我从石笋后探出目光，钉住你。
lines.en: I slide my gaze out from behind a stalagmite and pin you.

lines.zh: 我转头，洞壁上的影子也跟着转。
lines.en: I turn my head, and the shadows on the wall turn with me.

lines.zh: 隔着整条坑道，我感觉到你的体温。
lines.en: Across the whole tunnel, I feel the heat of your body.

lines.zh: 我抬起眼，黑暗里浮出两点幽光。
lines.en: I lift my eyes, and two pale lights float up in the dark.

lines.zh: 我侧耳，把你的脚步记了下来。
lines.en: I tilt an ear and memorize the sound of your steps.

lines.zh: 我缓缓回头，认出你是新来的。
lines.en: I turn slowly and recognize you as a newcomer.

lines.zh: 我从水洼的倒影里打量你。
lines.en: I study you in the reflection of a puddle.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的火把，讨厌那团光。
lines.en: I stare at your torch and hate that light.

lines.zh: 我把视线挪到你的后颈。
lines.en: I move my gaze to the back of your neck.

lines.zh: 我用触手探出你站的深度。
lines.en: I probe with a tendril to feel how deep you stand.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，你身上的伤口在恶化。
lines.en: Sssshhh, the wounds on you are worsening.

lines.zh: 黑暗中你感到一阵剧痛。
lines.en: Pain, sharp and intense, pierces through you.

lines.zh: 你感到自己的皮肉在腐烂。
lines.en: You feel your flesh rotting.

lines.zh: 你的伤口在蔓延，仿佛有什么在啃咬。
lines.en: Your wounds spread, as if something is gnawing on you.

lines.zh: 黑暗侵蚀你的身体，伤口剧痛。
lines.en: Darkness eats at your flesh, causing pain.

lines.zh: 伤口处传来阵阵寒意。
lines.en: Cold seeps into your wounds.

lines.zh: 黑暗的力量腐蚀着你的伤口。
lines.en: Darkness corrodes your wounds.

lines.zh: 痛苦中你感到一阵晕眩。
lines.en: Pain brings a dizziness.

lines.zh: 你仿佛听见伤口在吮吸你的生命。
lines.en: You hear your wounds sucking your life.

lines.zh: 伤口在黑暗中发出阵阵低鸣。
lines.en: Your wounds moan in the darkness.

lines.zh: 它的触手缠住你，却在你试图拔出时绷紧，将你拉入黑暗之中。
lines.en: Its tentacles wrap around you, tightening as you try to pull free, dragging you into the darkness.

lines.zh: 你感到一股寒意，像是它的目光穿过黑暗，锁定你的位置。
lines.en: A chill runs through you, as if its gaze penetrates the darkness, locking onto your position.

lines.zh: 它那闪烁着磷光的触角在黑暗中舞动，引诱你靠近。
lines.en: Its phosphorescent tentacles dance in the dark, enticing you closer.

lines.zh: 你感到某种无法言喻的欲望，想要探寻它那神秘的内心。
lines.en: An unnameable urge pulls at you, compelling you to explore its mysterious mind.

lines.zh: 它的声音低沉而诱惑，试图引导你走向它设定的陷阱。
lines.en: Its voice is a low, seductive whisper, tempting you into its trap.

lines.zh: 你看到它的眼睛在黑暗中闪烁，仿佛在等待着什么。
lines.en: Its eyes flash in the darkness, as if waiting for something.

lines.zh: 你被一种奇异的力量吸引，几乎无法抗拒地靠近它。
lines.en: You are drawn by an odd power, almost unable to resist the urge to approach.

lines.zh: 它的形体在黑暗中扭曲，似乎在呼唤你的注意。
lines.en: Its form distorts in the dark, calling for your attention.

lines.zh: 你感到自己被某种未知的力量吸引，无法抗拒。
lines.en: You feel an unknown force drawing you in, irresistible.

lines.zh: 它那诡异的歌声诱惑着你，想要把你引入深渊。
lines.en: Its eerie song tempts you, wishing to drag you into the abyss.

lines.zh: 你突然撞到一个坚硬的物体，但它却只是虚空的幻影。
lines.en: You collide with a hard object, but it's just a phantom of empty space.

lines.zh: 你撞上了它的触手，却被一股力量推离。
lines.en: You hit its tentacle, only to be pushed away by a force.

lines.zh: 你和它猛然碰撞，它的力量让你踉跄后退。
lines.en: You collide with it, its strength sending you stumbling back.

lines.zh: 它仿佛预见到了你的碰撞，轻易避开你的攻击。
lines.en: It seems to predict your collision, easily avoiding your attack.

lines.zh: 你试图靠近它，却因它的攻击而退后。
lines.en: You try to approach it, but retreat from its attack.

lines.zh: 你的撞击未能伤害到它，反而被它的力量反弹回去。
lines.en: Your collision does not harm it, instead being pushed back by its force.

lines.zh: 它以闪电般的速度避开你的撞击，让你措手不及。
lines.en: It dodges your collision with lightning speed, catching you off guard.

lines.zh: 你撞到它的防御，发出一串刺耳的声音。
lines.en: You collide with its defense, producing a series of harsh sounds.

lines.zh: 你撞上它的身体，感觉到了它的力量和硬度。
lines.en: You collide with its body, feeling its strength and hardness.

lines.zh: 它的防御让你的攻击几乎无效，只能感受到它的力量。
lines.en: Its defense makes your attack almost无效，只能感受到它的力量。

lines.zh: 它发出低沉的嘶吼，似乎在寻找伴侣。
lines.en: It lets out a deep growl, seemingly seeking a mate.

lines.zh: 它的身体开始发出耀眼的光芒，似乎在吸引同类。
lines.en: Its body starts emitting a bright light, as if attracting同类。

lines.zh: 它开始用触手触摸周围的地面，寻找潜在的伴侣。
lines.en: It begins touching the ground around it with its tentacles, searching for potential mates.

lines.zh: 它的声音变得温柔，似乎在呼唤它的同类。
lines.en: Its voice becomes gentle, as if calling to its kind.

lines.zh: 它的身体开始微微震动，似乎在释放某种信号。
lines.en: Its body starts to vibrate slightly, as if releasing a signal.

lines.zh: 它的光芒更加明亮，吸引着周围的生物。
lines.en: Its light becomes brighter, drawing in nearby creatures.

lines.zh: 它在洞穴中来回走动，似乎在寻找合适的伴侣。
lines.en: It walks back and forth in the cave, searching for a suitable mate.

lines.zh: 它的声音中充满了渴望，似乎渴望与同类交配。
lines.en: Its voice is filled with desire, yearning for mating with its kind.

lines.zh: 它开始用触手轻触地面，似乎在寻找合适的环境。
lines.en: It starts lightly touching the ground with its tentacles, searching for the right environment.

lines.zh: 它的光芒逐渐汇聚成一个光点，似乎在吸引同类。
lines.en: Its light gradually converges into a single point, as if attracting its kind.

lines.zh: 洞穴深处传来嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Sssss from deep within the cave.

lines.zh: 岩石缝隙间蠕动着一团阴影。
lines.en: A shadow writhes in the rock crevice.

lines.zh: 腐烂的肉块吸引着它。
lines.en: Decaying flesh draws it in.

lines.zh: 阴影中露出一双冰冷的眼睛。
lines.en: Cold eyes glint from the shadows.

lines.zh: 它发出低沉的咆哮声。
lines.en: It rumbles with a low growl.

lines.zh: 地面突然裂开，露出獠牙。
lines.en: The ground splits, revealing sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 它舔着沾满血迹的嘴唇。
lines.en: It licks blood-stained lips.

lines.zh: 阴影中伸出一只骨爪。
lines.en: A bone claw stretches from the shadows.

lines.zh: 腐烂的皮肤散发着恶臭。
lines.en: Rotten skin exudes a foul stench.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛紧盯着猎物。
lines.en: Its eyes fix on the prey.

lines.zh: 猎物就在那里。
lines.en: Prey is there.

lines.zh: 玩家踏入了它的领地。
lines.en: The player steps into its territory.

lines.zh: 它的感官捕捉到了玩家。
lines.en: Its senses pick up the player.

lines.zh: 影子在黑暗中聚焦。
lines.en: The shadow focuses in the darkness.

lines.zh: 它的声音引导它接近。
lines.en: Its sound guides it closer.

lines.zh: 它追踪着微弱的气息。
lines.en: It tracks a faint scent.

lines.zh: 玩家的气息让它心动。
lines.en: The player’s scent sets it aflutter.

lines.zh: 它感到猎物的气息微弱。
lines.en: It feels the prey’s scent weakening.

lines.zh: 阴影中的它逐渐苏醒。
lines.en: It stirs in the shadow.

lines.zh: 它的触手准备捕捉猎物。
lines.en: Its tentacles ready to grasp.

lines.zh: 地下暗流把你的气味送了过来。
lines.en: The underground current carried your scent to me.

lines.zh: 我记住了这条坑道的回音，你跑不掉。
lines.en: I have learned this tunnel's echo; you cannot run.

lines.zh: 我的触手一齐竖起，朝你的方向。
lines.en: All my tendrils rise at once, pointing your way.

lines.zh: 我在岩层里听见了你的心跳。
lines.en: I hear your heartbeat through the rock.

lines.zh: 等了这么多天，终于有人往下走。
lines.en: After so many days, someone finally came down.

lines.zh: 这一层洞穴归我，你走错了路。
lines.en: This cave level is mine; you took a wrong turn.

lines.zh: 它开始瞄准猎物。
lines.en: It starts to target the prey.

lines.zh: 它的目光锁定在目标上。
lines.en: Its gaze locks on the target.

lines.zh: 猎物成了它的晚餐。
lines.en: The prey is its meal.

lines.zh: 它开始用声音威胁猎物。
lines.en: It starts to intimidate the prey with sound.

lines.zh: 它准备用利爪攻击。
lines.en: It prepares to attack with claws.

lines.zh: 它的声音变得威胁。
lines.en: Its voice becomes threatening.

lines.zh: 它开始散发出致命气息。
lines.en: It starts to emit a deadly aura.

lines.zh: 它的触手准备缠住猎物。
lines.en: Its tentacles ready to ensnare.

lines.zh: 它的目光中闪烁着贪婪。
lines.en: Its eyes glimmer with greed.

lines.zh: 它准备吞噬猎物。
lines.en: It prepares to devour.

lines.zh: 我把触手慢慢收进暗处，准备扑出。
lines.en: I pull my tendrils back into the dark, ready to lunge.

lines.zh: 我压低声响，一寸寸缩短距离。
lines.en: I muffle my sounds and close the distance inch by inch.

lines.zh: 我算计着你的火把能照多远。
lines.en: I measure how far your torch can reach.

lines.zh: 我盯住你的脚踝，每一步都记下。
lines.en: I watch your ankles and count every step.

lines.zh: 我准备从你背后的岩缝里出来。
lines.en: I ready myself to come out of the crack behind you.

lines.zh: 我把影子铺到你脚下。
lines.en: I spread my shadow to your feet.

lines.zh: 我等你走到没有退路的窄道。
lines.en: I wait until you reach a passage with no way back.

lines.zh: 我的利爪在石头上磨出轻响。
lines.en: My claws scrape softly against the stone.

lines.zh: 我在计算扑过去的角度。
lines.en: I am working out the angle of my leap.

lines.zh: 我收起触手，只留下最锋利的那根。
lines.en: I retract my tendrils and keep only the sharpest one.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，锋利爪子划破黑暗！
lines.en: Sssss, sharp claws slice through the darkness!

lines.zh: 你听到什么了吗？阴影近了！
lines.en: Did you hear that? The shadow is coming!

lines.zh: 触手般的手臂抓住你！
lines.en: Tentacle-like arms grab you!

lines.zh: 你的哀号成为我的晚餐！
lines.en: Your screams are my dinner!

lines.zh: 无处可逃，陷入我的阴影！
lines.en: Nowhere to run, fall into my shadow!

lines.zh: 黑暗中，我的触手缠住你！
lines.en: In the darkness, my tentacles grab you!

lines.zh: 感受我的冰冷触感！
lines.en: Feel my cold touch!

lines.zh: 你触碰到我的真实了吗？
lines.en: Did you touch my reality?

lines.zh: 吞噬你，化为我的一部分！
lines.en: Devour you, become a part of me!

lines.zh: 陷入阴影，永不见天日！
lines.en: Fall into the shadow, never see light again!

lines.zh: 我从你脚边的阴影里刺出触手！
lines.en: A tendril stabs out of the shadow at your feet!

lines.zh: 我的爪子从背后扣住你的肩！
lines.en: My claws clamp onto your shoulder from behind!

lines.zh: 黑暗裹住你的头，别挣扎！
lines.en: The dark wraps your head, so stop struggling!

lines.zh: 我咬住你的火把，光该熄了！
lines.en: I bite down on your torch; the light should die!

lines.zh: 你踩进了我的影子，出不去了！
lines.en: You stepped into my shadow and cannot leave!

lines.zh: 我的触手在你骨头上收紧。
lines.en: My tendrils tighten around your bones.

lines.zh: 洞穴深处，我苏醒！
lines.en: Awake in the depths of the cave!

lines.zh: 玩家到来，猎物降临！
lines.en: Player arrives, prey arrives!

lines.zh: 地面震动，黑暗涌动！
lines.en: The ground shakes, darkness surges!

lines.zh: 我从地下深处爬出！
lines.en: I crawl from the depths!

lines.zh: 寂静中，黑暗苏醒！
lines.en: In silence, darkness awakens!

lines.zh: 等待猎物踏入我的领地！
lines.en: Wait for prey to enter my domain!

lines.zh: 腐烂的气息，引我苏醒！
lines.en: The stench of decay awakens me!

lines.zh: 深入洞穴，触碰我的领地！
lines.en: Dive into the cave, touch my domain!

lines.zh: 腐朽的洞壁，滋养我的力量！
lines.en: Decaying walls feed my strength!

lines.zh: 黑暗中，我永恒地徘徊！
lines.en: In the darkness, I eternally roam!

lines.zh: 坑道尽头的水声停了，因为我来了。
lines.en: The dripping at the tunnel's end stopped, because I am here.

lines.zh: 岩层裂开一道缝，我从里面挤出。
lines.en: A seam splits in the rock, and I squeeze out of it.

lines.zh: 这一层洞穴的黑暗忽然变浓。
lines.en: The darkness on this cave level suddenly thickens.

lines.zh: 我从积水的竖井底部爬上来。
lines.en: I climb up from the bottom of a flooded shaft.

lines.zh: 石笋之间，我的轮廓慢慢成形。
lines.en: Between the stalagmites, my outline slowly takes shape.

lines.zh: 深处的回声换成了我的呼吸。
lines.en: The echo from below turns into my breathing.

lines.zh: 我醒得比这一层洞穴更早。
lines.en: I woke long before this cave level did.

lines.zh: 我用触手攀着岩壁，一路往上。
lines.en: I haul myself up the wall with my tendrils.

lines.zh: 空气变冷，那是我靠近的信号。
lines.en: The air turns cold; that is the sign I am near.

lines.zh: 这一夜，我又被玩家的脚步唤醒。
lines.en: Tonight the player's footsteps woke me again.

lines.zh: 火焰撕裂你的皮肉。
lines.en: Flames tear at your flesh.

lines.zh: 你摔进了熔岩。
lines.en: You fell into lava.

lines.zh: 黑暗的水淹没你的伤口。
lines.en: Dark water engulfs your wounds.

lines.zh: 爆炸撕开你的皮肉。
lines.en: Explosion rips through your flesh.

lines.zh: 箭矢穿透你的皮肤。
lines.en: Arrow pierces your skin.

lines.zh: 黑暗魔法腐蚀你的伤口。
lines.en: Dark magic corrodes your wounds.

lines.zh: 饥饿让你的伤口更加疼痛。
lines.en: Starvation makes your wounds more painful.

lines.zh: 闪电烧灼你的皮肉。
lines.en: Lightning burns your flesh.

lines.zh: 无尽的黑暗吞噬你的伤口。
lines.en: Infinite darkness devours your wounds.
